semantics: cooldown_seconds = tempo mínimo após a última mensagem recebida antes de resposta automática; nova mensagem reinicia o relógio

scenarios.name: first_interaction_waits
scenarios.given: assistant active, conversation ai, cooldown_seconds=60, first incoming message arrived 10 seconds ago and there is no previous AI reply
expect: no automatic reply before 60 seconds from the latest incoming message

scenarios.name: new_message_resets_wait
scenarios.given: cooldown_seconds=60 and 50 seconds elapsed, then the customer sends another message
expect: the 60 second wait restarts from the newest message
one consolidated reply is produced after the wait

scenarios.name: cooldown_queue_after_due
scenarios.given: pending ai.cooldown and at least 60 seconds elapsed since the latest incoming message and last AI reply
expect: automatic cron does not bypass cooldown

scenarios.name: cooldown_human_takeover
scenarios.when: human takes over before queue processing
